rows.pitfalls_caveats: Do not use high capacity as positive activity evidence.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: normalized H100e capacity, largest contiguous domain, homogeneity fraction, non-partitioned fraction, power/cooling envelope

rows.ground_truth_labeling_use: Primary activity anchor; best first-pass candidate windows.
rows.pitfalls_caveats: Job splitting/account fragmentation can hide true scale.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: max concurrent normalized GPUs, linked-job GPU-hours, duration, site/domain fraction, contiguity, declared class

rows.ground_truth_labeling_use: Primary provisioning/account attribution in cloud settings.
rows.pitfalls_caveats: Reservations and high spend can be inference/HPC.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: batch launch size, reservation GPU-days, training-SKU fraction, billing CV/diurnal index, account/org aggregation

rows.pitfalls_caveats: High utilization is not semantic; counters may be disabled or spoofed under weak trust.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: median/p95 utilization, SM/tensor active, power fraction, HBM used, bandwidth, duty cycle above thresholds

rows.ground_truth_labeling_use: Strongest non-semantic evidence of one coordinated distributed run.
rows.pitfalls_caveats: Large MPI/HPC can mimic; sampling too coarse can miss steps.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: synchronized footprint, port p95 utilization, burst duty cycle, autocorrelation period, XmitWait/retry alignment, job-to-port coverage

rows.pitfalls_caveats: Cannot distinguish training from HPC by itself.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: rack/facility power fraction, energy, CV/diurnal ratio, thermal delta-T, throttling, power-to-telemetry residual

rows.pitfalls_caveats: Backups, ETL, and storage rebuilds can mimic large I/O.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: pre-run staging bytes, checkpoint size/periodicity, write fan-out, read/write ratio, export/egress after job

rows.ground_truth_labeling_use: Disambiguates training vs inference/HPC when authentic.
rows.pitfalls_caveats: Highly sensitive; guest isolation can block visibility.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: WORLD_SIZE, rank stability, framework class, image hash recurrence, command/env hashes, optimizer/checkpoint libraries

rows.pitfalls_caveats: Often unavailable; may need protected escalation and signatures.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: signed declared class, parameter count, tokens/examples, step count/time, loss curve, optimizer/checkpoint metadata

rows.ground_truth_labeling_use: Controls whether no-run claims and positive evidence are trustworthy.
rows.pitfalls_caveats: Integrity anomalies are not training proof unless aligned with activity/physical evidence.
rows.recommended_engineered_features: coverage vector, gap fraction, clock drift, counter resets, attestation validity, CC mode, collector hash, physical/firmware events
